title: Record to Cell Binding
description: Shared federation primitive binding one domain record to one canonical Cell_ID. Spatial membership is computed once by the geometry authority; domain repositories store the resulting Cell_ID on their records and filter on it rather than repeating geometry work. A record may bind to many cells (a flight path to dozens, a watershed to hundreds), so this is deliberately many-to-many and never collapses a record to a single cell.

Identity_Default.description: A Cell_ID is a spatial address, never an identity claim. Records sharing a cell are co-located, not the same entity.
